- **Proven liver care:** Doctors note that the liver naturally filters waste and recommend lifestyle habits—such as limiting alcohol, watching weight, avoiding unnecessary toxins, and reviewing medications or supplements with a healthcare provider—rather than relying on "detox" pills.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXBkt6cQnu26Km1tInaCxFty_lgYBG4TW-22w9qkjMikVEsTwM2ws-qr4m1HINq3pdqFkIPaSo_5S3K44SzprAKDDwdewqNqGszpoy8qJsUShB9Wa5zC3P8waKPQN5VLE6sdmDHmc-jWs)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF17u1Rts3wm91VZbPi9B38lAqu94yw2hWXq8RYDyq1KRi4mY9YCD5J2DEb7uxvMvC7SJhc4wbiEG47b2-GezXSOpD5Rx8dRkRSU6xnT0UNBgBrm35tOF8P-oXsHF28RvHvVJo_PFR1P1wF8uZ6A5YeHw4OIPkrls2t_wh1QOkXCT3XFlAXIpr9ZGzbYYGpEJCrFEcdyO0)
